facts.text: Melanie's wedding included flowers as part of the decor, specifically on white chairs.

evidence.quote: They were an important part of my wedding decor and always remind me of that day.
It must have been special at your wedding.

facts.text: Melanie's wedding ceremony took place in a greenhouse with people taking pictures.

evidence.quote: It was amazing, Caroline. The day was full of love and joy. Everyone we love was there to celebrate us - it was really special.
Marrying my partner and promising to be together forever was the best part.

facts.text: Melanie associates flowers with growth, beauty, and the appreciation of small moments.

evidence.quote: Flowers bring joy. They represent growth, beauty and reminding us to appreciate the small moments.

facts.text: Melanie's wedding included a blue vase with a bouquet of sunflowers and roses.

evidence.quote: What do you think of these? [image: a photo of a blue vase with a bouquet of sunflowers and roses]
